candidate_findings.trigger: Focus a checked missing ID near the bottom; remove it with Space, None or All.
candidate_findings.risk: The option vanishes while selectedID remains orphaned; pickerIndex falls back to zero without revealing the replacement row. A second toggle may affect the first option outside the current viewport.

candidate_findings.trigger: Focus a lower row, then shrink the viewport or move the same ID to another index in an inert inventory update.
candidate_findings.risk: Viewport synchronization does not call keepPickerVisible for resize or inventory replacement. Stable identity may survive while its rendered row is outside the viewport.
